RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Do not raise the gender composition of the panel. Citing an all-female panel alone does not constitute evidence of bias and will undermine your professional standing. Selection committees typically reflect available administrative staff rather than intentional bias.

While unconscious bias cannot be entirely ruled out, principal appointments heavily weigh interview performance, strategic vision, references, and leadership fit alongside formal qualifications. 

Instead, follow up professionally on your request for the written explanation. Examine the evaluation criteria and feedback against the advertised requirements. If clear procedural irregularities or inexplicable scoring discrepancies appear once you receive the statement, consult a union representative or legal adviser to evaluate objective grounds before considering any formal complaint.
